policy.rule: Every source is listed with its licence, its landing page, and the verification status actually achieved from this sandbox. Nothing is cited that was not read. 'REACHED' means the page or file was fetched and read during this session; 'BLOCKED' means the host is unreachable from the sandbox and the copy in this repository is a hash-pinned mirror instead.
policy.sandbox_network: Outbound from the shell is limited to github.com, codeload.github.com, api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org. DrivenData and Dropbox return HTTP 000; mrdata.usgs.gov and gdr.openei.org are likewise unreachable. A companion page-fetch channel is not shell-restricted and was used to read the pages marked REACHED.

organizer_and_rules.what: Competition problem description: metric definition, mathematical representation, scoring example, submission format
organizer_and_rules.evidence: Read in full this session. The distance-weighted Tversky definition, k(d)=max(1-d/R,0) with R=300 m, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, and the worked example TP_w=3.00 FP_w=1.89 FN_w=2.00 -> 0.60 were transcribed verbatim into scripts/gems_metric.py, which reproduces 0.602652.

Read 2026-10-08. Rank 1 xiaofanhu 0.3774; rank 2 alexoktaba 0.3345; rank 3 nchuzhoy 0.3262; rank 7 DARD 0.3195; rank 13 extradr19 0.2778; rank 17 wbg1 0.2750. The brief's '0.3195 is the highest score right now' is therefore a dated observation: 0.3195 is rank 7, and the current best public score is 0.3774.

HTTP 000 from the sandbox; requires a DrivenData login regardless. Consequence: no model can be trained here. The label and grid rasters used in this repository are hash-pinned mirrors of the organizer files (see below) and the label mirror matches the SHA-256 pinned in a sibling receipt.

organizer_and_rules.what: DOE / NLR GEMS Prize Official Rules, September 2026
organizer_and_rules.evidence: Read this session. Section 3.2 verified: 'You must submit a single GeoTIFF with a single raster layer at 100-meter resolution ... (three submissions per week)', and 'The labels for this prize come from the USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database and from a set of newly identified faults labeled by geology experts at the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) and USGS.' Section 3.2 also requires disclosure in the narrative of any generative-AI use.
Referenced by the organizer page as the submission CRS and asserted byte-for-byte on every raster here by rasterio (str(crs) == 'EPSG:32611').
Background only; the metric used here is the organizer's own definition, not the generic index.

evidence_layers_used_by_the_submission.what: USGS State Geologic Map Compilation fault layers, Nevada and California state map packages
evidence_layers_used_by_the_submission.evidence: Not reachable from the shell. The pinned receipt at data/external/GEMSDOE30_external_receipt.json records a successful fetch from a GitHub Actions runner with SHA-256 3b333ac0… (NV) and 78765ba4… (CA), and states the licence.
evidence_layers_used_by_the_submission.licence: US Government work / public domain (USGS Mineral Resources Program), per the pinned receipt

derived_input_used_here.note: 100 m rasterisation of the NV+CA fault layers, uint8, nodata 255, 82,151 positive cells. Rasterised by a sibling pipeline, not by this session; the rasterisation is monotone (no smoothing), so the fault cells are a subset of the vector geometry.
